title: davallia dicksonioides
intro: Davallia dicksonioides, commonly known as the Davallia fern, is a type of plant belonging to the Davalliaceae family. It is a species of fern native to tropical regions of Asia and Pacific Islands. The Davallia dicksonioides has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects.
